scope: Family-level semantic-honesty accounting for every source descriptor that emits at least one accepted production ERC-7730 leaf.
claim_limit: This is not leaf-by-leaf deployment proof. A pinned-evidence record names the exact evidence subset available for that source family; its accepted_leaf_count is accounting only and must not be read as saying every emitted deployment or format is evidenced.

classification_contract.pinned-evidence: At least one accepted route/deployment subset in this source family is bound by the named offline evidence package. The evidence scope, not the source leaf count, defines the claim.
classification_contract.shared-standard-implementation: Every accepted format in the source is inherited unchanged from the shared ERC-4626 rendering template. This records review reuse only; it does not prove any deployment implements ERC-4626 honestly.
classification_contract.lower-priority-residual: No pinned deployed-semantics package is named for an accepted subset and the exact shared ERC-4626 template rule does not apply. Any future record in this class must name a concrete GitHub successor issue that owns reconciliation.
